orgs.name: Asociación Chilena de Food Trucks
orgs.notes: Named as one of the sector's guilds in El Desconcierto (2026-06-11, https://eldesconcierto.cl/hoja-ruta/food-trucks-energia-solar-y-menos-emisiones-la-tendencia-que-busca-instalarse-el-auge-del-negocio-n5459518), but no website, social account, leaders or dated activity of its own found. No contact route.

orgs.name: The Street Food Chile A.G.
orgs.notes: Trade association whose president was Jean-Claude Patri Didier (Cool Crêpes), per a 2015 article. Nothing newer found.

orgs.name: Asociación Food Trucks Viña del Mar
orgs.notes: Facebook page describes a nonprofit that organises activities, raises funds and keeps shared supplier/collaborator lists (search snippet). Facebook blocked fetching, so no post dates or follower count.

orgs.name: Agrupación Food Truck Talcahuano
orgs.notes: Facebook page of a nonprofit group of small food-service businesses (search snippet). No dated activity or news found; may overlap with the Biobío group below.

orgs.name: Agrupación de Food Trucks del Biobío
orgs.notes: Led by María Elena Hono, active since 2020; organised the first Biobío Food Truck Festival (26–27 Aug 2023, Parque Bicentenario, 40+ trucks). No later edition or social account found.

orgs.name: Espacio FoodTruck Ñuble A.G.
orgs.notes: Bio: 'the first food truck group in the Ñuble region, want to join? Contact us'. The newest dated post is a January 2023 New Year post, and the website domain no longer resolves.

orgs.name: Club de Foodtrucks
orgs.notes: Group of truck owners promoting each other; its bio describes a joint show at Alameda 333, Santiago (a venue that opened in 2017). Posts have no visible dates; small and probably dormant.

orgs.name: Tropa Foodtruck

emails.reason: Published on their own site; MX mail.tropafoodtruck.cl

orgs.notes: Calls itself a 'group of entrepreneurs' (food trucks, carts, catering) for corporate events, production companies and agencies, with 10+ years running. Closer to an events catering collective than a trade body; no dated activity found.

orgs.name: Espacio Food Truck
orgs.members_estimate: claims access to 400+ food truck units (Facebook page description, search snippet)
orgs.notes: Events organiser that places trucks in its own spaces and at events in and outside Santiago, and invites trucks to work with it. Facebook blocked fetching, so no dates.

orgs.name: Patio Franklin (Franklin Truck fair)
orgs.notes: Patio at San Isidro and Biobío with food-truck-format vendors; it ran the first Franklin Truck food truck fair in Oct 2024. The organiser is not named, and no social account or contact was found.

orgs.name: Patio de Foodtrucks Potrerillos
orgs.notes: Food truck patio at Parque Potrerillos, promoted to visitors of the Feria Internacional de Artesanías de Viña del Mar (Instagram snippet). No dated evidence.

orgs.name: Merkado Bilbao
orgs.notes: Small food truck space on Av. Bilbao, with 5 trucks in 2019. Nothing newer found.
